title: Cell Fractionation
author: Peter Vangheluwe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bazhif36
materials: Solutions LIS buffer pH 7.5 - 10 mM Tris.HCl pH 7.5 [60.57 mg/50 mL] - 0.5 mM MgCl2.6H2O [5.0825 mg/50 mL] - Protease inhibitors (always add fresh) - 4°C, fridge 1 1 M solution - 0.5 M sucrose - 10 mM Tris.HCl pH 7.3 - 40 µM CaCl2 - 0.23 mM PMSF (always add fresh) - 1 mM DTT (always add fresh) - -20°C, common drawer

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Collect medium from SH‑SY5Y, hATP13A2 cultures, wash cells with PBS (no CaCl₂, MgCl₂), incubate with TrypLE at 37 °C, collect cells, centrifuge 5 min at 300 g, decant supernatant, wash pellet with PBS, centrifuge 5 min at 300 g, decant supernatant, then proceed to total‑lysate or microsome preparation.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with PBS (without CaCl₂, MgCl₂)
Proceed to lysate or microsome preparation

steps.title: Prepare total cell lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in REPA lysis buffer supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors, incubate on ice for 30 min (overnight optional), centrifuge 30 min at 12 000 rpm (≈15 000 g) to pellet DNA, retain the supernatant and determine protein concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add REPA lysis buffer with protease/phosphatase inhibitors

steps.title: Lyse cells for microsomes
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL hypotonic LIS buffer, let swell on ice 10–15 min, homogenize with a Dounce (40 strokes), add 2 mL of 1 M solution and homogenize an additional 20 strokes, then transfer the homogenate to Sarstedt tubes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 2 mL hypotonic LIS buffer
Incubate on ice 10–15 min for swelling

steps.title: Differential centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 1 000 g, 4 °C to pellet nuclei; transfer supernatant to a new Sarstedt tube, centrifuge 20 min at 9 000 rpm, 4 °C to pellet mitochondria/lysosomes, resuspend this pellet in 0.25 M sucrose (+ SF), transfer the remaining supernatant to a Beckman tube, equilibrate with 1 M solution, ultracentrifuge 35 min at 200 000 g (48 000 rpm), 4 °C to pellet microsomes, discard supernatant, clean tubes, resuspend microsomal pellet in 0.25 M sucrose (+ SF) and flash‑freeze in liquid N₂.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to new Sarstedt tube
Resuspend pellet in 0.25 M sucrose (+ SF)
Transfer supernatant to Beckman centrifuge tube
Ultracentrifuge 35 min at 200 000 g (48 000 rpm), 4 °C (microsomal pellet)
Resuspend microsomal pellet in 0.25 M sucrose (+ SF)
